from pathlib import Path
workspace=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace')
programs=workspace/'programs'
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_text='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    anchors = {color: col for col, color in enumerate(grid[0]) if color != 0}
    for color, col in anchors.items():
        markers = [(r, c) for r in range(1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not markers:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][col] = color
            continue
        for r, c in markers:
            for rr in range(min(0, r), max(0, r) + 1):
                out[rr][col] = color
            for cc in range(min(col, c), max(col, c) + 1):
                out[r][cc] = color
    return out
'''
program_path=programs/'task-c5a936fe.py'
program_path.write_text(program_text)
exec(compile(program_text, str(program_path), 'exec'))
